description.value: Liuyishou Hotpot Robson is the Vancouver West End outpost of an international Chinese hotpot chain with locations across North America, including two other BC locations in Richmond and Burnaby. The restaurant sits on Robson Street, a main artery running from downtown Vancouver toward Stanley Park — a natural corridor for city-touring cyclists. It offers an all-you-can-eat hotpot format alongside a regular menu.
